name: magpie-tabbit2api
description: Tabbit (web.tabbit.com / web.tabbit.ai) as a magpie provider that serves real client tools: the tool definitions ride in the prompt as XML, the reply is parsed back into OpenAI tool_calls, and the tool result resumes the same turn.

summary.en: Tabbit over its own chat API, with client tools that actually run. Differs from opencode-tabbit-auth: that one declares tool support it does not have and refuses tools; this one carries the tool definitions in the prompt, parses the model's <invoke> blocks back into finish_reason tool_calls, and resumes the same turn once the caller returns a result.
summary.zh: 把 Tabbit 接进 magpie，并让客户端工具真的能跑。与 opencode-tabbit-auth 的差异：后者声明了工具支持却没有实现、带 tools 的请求直接失效；本插件把工具定义以 XML 写进提示词，模型输出的 <invoke> 块被解析成 finish_reason tool_calls，工具结果回填后同一轮继续生成。

author: cv-superding
